tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search fresh GTIN products in the catalog your affiliate can deliver (freshness, permissions and caps apply). tools.name: get_product_feed

tools.name: get_catalog_stats
tools.description: Public GTIN catalog counts as of generated_at, using the same stored snapshot as /api/v1/public/catalog-stats/. Fixed one-hour validity; snapshot_stale marks older counts, served for up to 7 days. No affiliate data or amounts.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List active Clickwise deals and offers, optionally filtered by language, category, country or merchant.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Fetch the full record for a single deal by its slug. Returns title, description, code, discount, target_url, etc., in the requested language.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: List Clickwise news announcements about affiliate programs (policy changes, launches, shutdowns, commission updates).

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Fetch the full record for a single news article by its slug.

tools.name: find_affiliate_programs
tools.description: Use this first when someone without a Clickwise account asks which merchants to promote: it ranks live programs by fit for a described site, app, newsletter or social channel. tools.name: request_tracked_links
tools.description: Use this when you have no Clickwise account yet and want tracked links: it creates a provisional affiliate and returns links for the programs that can issue one to it. Email is optional; the account is claimed and payout details are added later (update_profile). With an API key use create_tracking_l

tools.name: get_monetization_feed
tools.description: Use this when a publisher without an account wants links ready to render on a site or app: it creates a provisional Clickwise affiliate and tracked links, as request_tracked_links does, and also returns cards, an HTML embed snippet and a JSON feed. tools.name: get_tracked_link_request
tools.description: Fetch a link request, affiliate RefId, review status, and issued links using its access secret.

tools.name: request_merchant_onboarding
tools.description: Alias of create_program. Create a program for its first payment. An agent calls this at a person's request. Default commission 25%, percent range 10–50%; recurring_months: 0 only. No setup fee; you pay on approved sales. The agent never accepts the Clickwise merchant terms on its own: send terms_acc

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: Use this to browse the whole live catalogue page by page, filtered by merchant, category or country, when find_affiliate_programs' ranked top matches are not enough. No key needed; it shows programs anyone can join. For the programs your API key is approved in use list_my_programs.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update a creator's monetization profile (claim email, display name, website, country, payment method) using the application_id + access_secret returned by request_tracked_links. Overwrites the fields provided. Lets a creator's assistant complete claim/payout details without leaving chat.

tools.name: get_click_report
tools.description: Your own native Clickwise redirect clicks for an inclusive date range. Returns individual clicks and total, excluding bots by default; upstream network clicks are not included. tools.name: list_my_programs
tools.description: Use this when you hold a Clickwise affiliate API key and need the programs that key is approved to promote, with link readiness and your existing link count; set include_available to add the ones you can apply to. For discovery without an account use find_affiliate_programs or list_programs. Require

tools.name: create_tracking_links
tools.description: Use this when you already have a Clickwise affiliate API key and want tracking links for programs you are approved in: one per item (the same program and subid return the same link), optionally deep-linking to a landing_url on the merchant's site. Each item reports its own status; a failed item neve

tools.name: get_performance_report
tools.description: Your conversions and commission (what you earn), grouped by day, week, month, subid, campaign or status, for up to 366 days (default: last 30). Daily/weekly/monthly series include empty periods. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: B

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: Your individual conversions (default: last 90 days) with status, commission, currency and subid, plus a per-subid rollup. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: Use this when an affiliate asks when they get paid: approved commission not yet paid (per currency and in USD), commission still pending review, the next payment as an estimate with its threshold, and the payment method as its type (a bank account shows only its last 4 digits). Read-only; never retu

tools.name: apply_to_program
tools.description: Ask to join a program (program_id from list_my_programs with include_available, or a campaign_id). Clickwise reviews the fit; the result is approved or pending. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.

tools.name: create_program
tools.description: Create a program for its first payment. An agent calls this at a person's request. Default commission 25%, percent range 10–50%; recurring_months: 0 only. No setup fee; you pay on approved sales. The agent never accepts the Clickwise merchant terms on its own: send terms_accepted with terms_version

tools.name: get_program_status
tools.description: Read the application and pending question using application_id and access_secret.

tools.name: answer_program_question
tools.description: Answer the application question. An agent calls this at a person's request.

tools.name: get_merchant_credentials
tools.description: get_merchant_credentials: Returns a merchant API token only if the account has none yet. If one exists, it answers 409 and explains where the account holder can copy it. It never reveals an existing token.

tools.name: get_tracking_link
tools.description: Issue a nonpayable house probe link, integration steps and a prompt for Lovable, Bolt or v0. An agent calls this at a person's request. Merchant Bearer token required.

tools.name: get_conversions_key
tools.description: Reveal a new conversions key once, or rotate with rotate=true. An agent calls this at a person's request. Merchant Bearer token required.

tools.name: get_integration_status
tools.description: Read authenticated test-sale evidence and the last real sale. Merchant Bearer token required.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read native direct program clicks, pending, approved and rejected conversions, commission by currency and billing status. Merchant Bearer token required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product_feed, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, request_merchant_onboarding, get_payment_status, create_program, get_tracking_link · Private data: search_products, get_product_feed, get_deal, get_news, find_affiliate_programs, request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, list_programs, get_click_report, list_my_programs, create_tracking_links, get_performance_report, list_conversions, get_payment_status, apply_to_program, get_merchant_credentials, get_tracking_link, get_conversions_key, get_integration_status, get_results · Public sink: request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, request_merchant_onboarding, update_profile, create_program · Destructive: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product_feed, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, request_merchant_onboarding, get_payment_status, create_program, get_tracking_link · Private data: search_products, get_product_feed, get_deal, get_news, find_affiliate_programs, request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, list_programs, get_click_report, list_my_programs, create_tracking_links, get_performance_report, list_conversions, get_payment_status, apply_to_program, get_merchant_credentials, get_tracking_link, get_conversions_key, get_integration_status, get_results · Public sink: request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, request_merchant_onboarding, update_profile, create_program · Destructive: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
